reason: My diary and my memory already work, and customers who take udhaar are regulars I have known for years. A bot messaging them about money will upset them, and I will not risk that for an app.
objection: Chasing udhaar through a bot will upset my regulars. Also, my orders come by phone call and in person, and I do not trust a machine to read my Hindi orders correctly and keep my stock right.
would_change_my_mind: If my son tried it free on my own real orders for a few weeks and it got them right, and I could see that reminders go out only when I choose, one customer at a time.
